formulaBlock.normalization: 'Aqua/Water/Eau' and 'Parfum/Fragrance' are single slash-synonym entries; packet positions = normalized ID-2 positions (30 entries).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Low by C6: no prominent strong anionic; earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the mild anionic Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate @2 with prominent glucoside/amphoteric co-surfactants Decyl Glucoside @3, Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4 (and Coco-Glucoside @12). Coconut Acid @13 (soap with Sodium Hydroxide) and Disodium Tetrapropenyl Succinate @14 are carboxylate-type co-ingredients outside the strong-anionic classes and do not change C6.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: an early (E3-prominent) Amodimethicone @11 plus cationic Starch Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @17 and light refatters (Glyceryl Oleate @15, Lecithin @16, Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate @23), humectant Urea @25. C2 not met: no pearlizing wax or payload lipid/fatty alcohol as the pearlizing/fatty element (weak refatters do not fill it). Counter-signal: silicone + cationic + refatters + humectant come close to C2, so high is the neighbor; but both systems sit in the sub-1 % alphabetical zone (11-17), behind menthol/essential oils.

excluded: Rosmarinus Officinalis Leaf Oil @6, Mentha Piperita Oil @7 (essential oils, 6.4)
unresolved: Sodium Hydrolyzed Potato Starch Dodecenylsuccinate @10 (anionic modified-starch emulsifier/stabilizer; no cationic charge; not judged to move the band)
Disodium Tetrapropenyl Succinate @14 (anionic succinate co-surfactant/hydrotrope; reset side, no deposition)

alphabeticalRun.entries: Amodimethicone, Coco-Glucoside, Coconut Acid, Disodium Tetrapropenyl Succinate, Glyceryl Oleate, Lecithin, Starch Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride

wLine.note: Run 11-17 does not contain the earliest cleansing surfactant (Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate @2), so its second entry Coco-Glucoside @12 is the tail candidate. Plausible: (i) taurate @2 before it; (ii) run entries ignored; after the run no cleansing surfactant, alkanolamide or pearlizing wax before the cap (PEG-150 Distearate @18 is not a structurant for (ii)). No candidate in positions 1-11.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Both deposition systems (Amodimethicone @11, Starch HPTC @17) lie inside an alphabetical sub-1 % zone and behind menthol/essential oils, i.e. likely trace-to-low dose (argues low); against that, amodimethicone is a persistent amino-silicone and the mild C6 chassis gives weak reset (argues heavier).
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Two distinct deposition families (amino-silicone + cationic starch polymer) plus weak refatters in a mild low-reset chassis plausibly leave noticeable but bounded residue.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not low: two families converge with weak reset, so 'one light polymer' is not available as a reason (W2). Not high: no payload lipid or rich architecture, and both systems are at low dose in the alphabetical tail zone, so a strongly coating result is not supported.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Dose of the late silicone/polymer unknown (alphabetical zone); low is the more realistic neighbor than high.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: amodimethicone @11 + cationic starch @17 + weak refatters with weak C6 reset; neighbor low.
